main.description: Ban an account instance-wide: one instance removal decision on at://<did> and a !takedown label on the DID, carrying exp for a temporary ban. While the ban is in force the account's posts, comments and votes are refused. A ban in force or lapsed is replaced by a new one. Instance authority and actor identity come from the authenticated service context, never request fields.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: Authentication is required; authenticate with an authorized service account before retrying.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The authenticated actor lacks permission; do not retry unless its moderation authority changes.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The request is incomplete or malformed, including a subject that is not a DID or an expiresAt not after the server's current time; correct it before retrying.

errors.name: InvalidSubject
errors.description: The DID is an indexed community with no account activity, or a trusted bridge community; do not retry.

errors.name: StateConflict
errors.description: expectedVersion is stale, or the DID has an active community removal; refetch getSubjectState before retrying.

errors.name: IdempotencyConflict
errors.description: The same key was reused with a different request; do not retry with that key.

errors.name: UnsupportedReason
errors.description: The reason is not supported for this action; choose a supported reason before retrying.

errors.name: ModerationUnavailable
errors.description: The moderation service is temporarily unavailable; retry later.

subject.description: DID of the account to ban; an indexed community DID is refused with InvalidSubject unless it also has account activity and is not a trusted bridge community

expectedVersion.description: Opaque subject-state version of at://<subject> expected by the caller

idempotencyKey.description: Opaque key that makes equivalent ban requests idempotent

reason.description: Public reason classification for banning the account

expiresAt.description: When the ban ends with no further action; omitted for a permanent ban. It must be after the server's current time, is stored at millisecond precision and is part of the idempotency request

privateNote.description: Private administrative note retained only on the admin action
